text:
katie-se: Quick Q — after PartnerConf dinner last night, we covered meals for 6 external partners + 4 employees. I used the team virtual card. Do we submit as company-paid client entertainment or split with partners? Also what details do you need for Concur? Thanks.

maria-peopleops: Congrats on the event! Short answer: client entertainment can be company-paid but needs preapproval if >$500 per event or includes alcohol. For post-facto: file under 'Client Entertainment' and attach guest list + orgs + business purpose. We need itemized receipt(s).

dave-finance: Also need the virtual card txn ID and final total. If partners contributed and paid separately, upload partner receipt and mark as 'Paid by third party' and include amount paid. If everyone was on company card, we need split lines per person with subtotal lines in Concur.

olivia-pm: we didn't collect separate receipts for two cocktails — is an attestation ok?

maria-peopleops: If an itemized receipt is missing for a line, manager attestation is allowed but you must note which items are estimates and get manager sign-off. Finance may request refunds for alcohol over policy limits.

katie-se: total was $1,230. virtual card last4 1234. we had one external vendor rep who left early and paid for their dessert separately (cash).

dave-finance: Upload the full virtual card receipt + cash receipt from vendor as 'Third-party payment'. On the Concur expense, set expense_type=ClientEntertainment, add attendees as comment. For tax reclaim, keep copies of invoices showing business purpose.

maria-peopleops: policy link: https://intranet.redwood.com/policies/entertainment-expenses. Need attendee list with role/company and brief business purpose line per attendee.

concur-bot: Reminder: Concur requires submission within 30 days. Use code CLIENT_ENT. Attach receipts (pdf/jpg). See how-to: https://tools.redwood.com/concur-guide

katie-se: thanks all — will upload receipts & attestation now. tagging @dave-finance for quick review :pray:

dave-finance: Happy to review, will confirm once claims are in. :thumbsup:
